integrity: Proof reconstructs containment, maximal determinant, exact John contact covariance and Gaussian Laplace asymptotics. Numerical checks are supplementary.
scientific_limitations: Proved for dimension m>=2 and fixed endpoint half-separation 0<d<1. High-dimensional errors are pointwise in d. Two-point ball convex hulls, not two-ball intersections. Claims include analytic proof and optional finite computational checks only; no external independent scientific audit.
title: Exact John ellipsoids and asymptotically vanishing ellipsoid-volume deficit for two-point spindles
